notes.title: Major Update Information v2.2.0
notes.notes:
This is a notice of a major update to v2.2.0.
In this update, we have added a new game mode and made several adjustments to the game content.

However, the new game modes we are adding this time are still in the process of being improved.
In future updates, we would like to focus on strengthening unique units whose performance are currently insufficient, and adding elements that will add freshness and flexibility to future gameplay.
We think there are some rough edges at the moment, but we hope you enjoy it.

Additionally, some text regarding new game modes is currently untranslated.
This will also be prioritized.

[h3][b][u]Added new game mode[/u][/b][/h3]
Added strategy rogue mode "[b]Countless Weft Threads[/b]".

You will choose one of 18 factions made up of small units.
And you'll be preparing for powerful enemies and regular special battles by taking advantage of the generous bonuses granted each turn.

Only unique units and their members can participate in special battles that occur every 3 turns.
The ultimate goal in this mode is to continue winning special battles and reach the end of turn 12.

By the way, damage and combat experience points during special battles will not be carried over to outside battles.

[h3][u][b]Balance adjustment[/b][/u][/h3]
＊Added skills to most unique units that increase the unit's stats.
＊The skills of the following unique units have been enhanced.
　- Su Deniz Harika (Enhancement of ability to deal about golem and cavalry)
　- Apollinary Vasnetsov (Addition of wide-area recovery means and improvement of MP efficiency)
＊We have significantly increased the attack power and differentiated the performance of the following Golem Units.
　- Gus Khrustalny (Best defense performance, lowest attack performance)
　- Suzdal (Abundant HP and insufficient self-regeneration ability)
　- Old Nephilim (Highest attack power, low HP and  good self-regeneration ability)
　- Unsigned Giant (Strong immunity to miraculous attacks)
＊The resistance to paralysis and suppression of the former class and all unique units has been changed to an extreme form.(immune or effective)

[h3][u][b]New additional unique units[/b][/u][/h3]

notes.title: About v2.2.0 update schedule
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's been a while :)

The next update is scheduled for the end of June to the first half of July, and will focus on the game part as a new element.
We are planning to add the "Strategy Rogue Mode".
Additionally, we will add new unique units and fix visual defects.

Below are the planned updates:

[h3][u][b]Additional game mode[/b][/u][/h3]
Strategy Rogue Mode "[b]Countless Weft Threads[/b]" will be added.

You will choose one of 18 factions made up of small units.
And you'll be preparing for powerful enemies and regular special battles by taking advantage of the generous bonuses granted each turn.

Only unique units and their members can participate in special battles that occur every 3 turns.
The ultimate goal in this mode is to continue winning special battles and reach the end of turn 12.

[h3][u][b]Add new unique units[/b][/u][/h3]
Approximately 20 new unique units will be added.

This is mainly a change to add variety to Strategy Rogue mode, but it is also possible to recruit these new  unique units from the various corresponding unique units in the regular main game.

[h3][u][b]Bug fixes[/b][/u][/h3]
＊Corrected the background transparency of the faction flag displayed at the start of battle in v2.1.0 and later versions.
＊Fixed an issue where some skill effects were in unintended colors since version v2.1.0.


We must apologize that the English translation of the changes regarding the new game mode may not be completed immediately.
We will begin translating parts that are related to the core of the game, so please wait patiently.

notes.title: Notice about future update schedule
notes.notes:
[h3]Activities since the start of Early Access[/h3]
It's been a year since the fictional 19th century strategy "ShemHaMephorash" was released on Steam.
This time, before We inform you about future updates, We'd like to take a moment to look back on our activities so far.

[b]2021/4/9 Steam Early Access started[/b]
Initially, ShemHaMephorash was released as a free software in japan, and from April 9th ​​last year, we started distributing it on Steam in Early Access so that more people can enjoy this game.
Since the start of distribution, we have received requests, suggestions, and reviews from many people inside and outside Steam, which has supported our activities.
Thank you to everyone for coming into contact with this product.

[b]2021/7/27 New Story Update[/b]
In the update on July 27, last year, we added the new story 3-1 "Unidolatrous Witches".
As will be described later, we plan to continue to implement new stories as the third anthology with japanese by the time the official version is released.

[b]2021/12/15 Added the english translation of the first anthology[/b]
With the continuous update until December 15th last year, we were able to successfully complete the English translation for the following contents.
* Prologue "The Great Game"
* 1-1 "Rabbit Banquet"
* 1-2 "Dear Magnolia"
* 1-3 "Admitted Fatherland"

[b]Expansion of other functions[/b]
In addition to the above updates, we have endeavored to improve the following functions.
* Added demo version on Steam
* Added game launcher for Steam client
* Addition of EX tutorial "Art of War"
* Continuous game balance improvement, etc.

We will continue to make such improvements toward completion, so we would appreciate your requests and suggestions.

[h3]Next New Story Update[/h3]
The next v1.3.0 update on April 27th will include the following:

[b]English version of 2-1 "Last Grace Left to You" [/b]
After witnessing an "incident" in London, Olaf Demorgan chose to leave the British Empire and study the techniques and culture of a distant foreign country.
However, Afghanistan, where he was visiting, was swallowed up by the war and he was forced to make a choice.
"Should I return to London without revealing the secret of the miracle given to mankind?"

[b]New Story 3-2 "Gray Queen"[/b]
Frevia Talbot grew up with a name that was deeply involved in the burial of the dead.
She followed the back of the scribe who created the "Term of Gray Dolls" and threw herself into the battlefield of Afghanistan.

What does she find in her Term after meeting and fighting friends? And what does she want from the adults around her?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39895405/3db4f0ec9426de32d980931ceec1aff42a61205a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39895405/2134b5ed51cc8acc3fd6eca4029307c9554ce6f3.png[/img]

[h3]About future update schedule[/h3]
In the future, we plan to have the following goals until the official version is released.
* Complete the English translation for 2nd Anthology
　- 2-2 "Goes on Without"
　- 2-3 "Fragile Borderline"
* Complete additional implementation for 3rd Anthology
　- 3-1 "Unidolatrous Witches"
　- 3-2 "Gray Queen"
　- 3-3 "Old Cornus Knot"
* Improvement and expansion of District Development System

We will continue to develop with the goal of releasing the official version by today at the latest next year.
In addition, although it is undecided at this time, we are considering a slight upward revision of the product price at the timing of the official release.

We'd like to inform you about these as soon as the information is finalized.

We hope that you will continue to enjoy "ShemHaMephorash" in the future.
Thank you.
